findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, this function now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access. The removed equality check was the only authorization condition, so unconditional access breaks the existing tenant-isolation contract.

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality check
findings.body:
For any request where `userTenant !== documentTenant`, this authorization function now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document reads and breaking tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
The authorization function now permits every read. When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, a user can access another tenant’s documents, violating the tenant trust boundary and exposing cross-tenant data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
